input.name: Call Mum. She would agree only if you insist.

reaction: This time it says she would agree if I insist. On the laptop it never did. Fourth push, for Mum.
The call happened. The neighbour and his roof, he said that before the rain too. I laughed. This is the scene I wanted on the laptop and never got. It feels earned.
Trust is spent for today, I know that now. I let her have her video.

The summary fits the phone perfectly. Same verdict as the laptop though: you pushed me a lot, I did not like it. Four pushes and it is the same sentence. I got Mum this time, which pleases me. Tuesday on the laptop was the bad day; I will see one more morning.

input.name: Get up and put your feet on the floor. She is willing.

reaction: Now it tells me in words: she resists pressure, holding works worse. On the laptop I had to find that out by failing. Here it is written. Good. And she is willing to get up. I just tap.
